title: Reserve the app name in both stores
summary: Create the app record in App Store Connect and Play Console with the approved name and package name.
why: App names are unique on the App Store; if not reserved early, someone else can take it. Release automation and account verification (`fastlane verify_accounts`) do not work without these records.
prerequisites: An App ID (Identifier) registration in Apple for the package name — in step 1.

steps.title: Register the Bundle ID in Apple
steps.detail: **Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Identifiers → +** → *App IDs* → *App* → Description: the app name, Bundle ID: **Explicit** and the package name above → the required capabilities (**Sign in with Apple**, **Push Notifications**) → **Register**.

steps.title: Create the app in App Store Connect
steps.detail: **Apps → + → New App** → platform iOS, name, primary language, Bundle ID (from the list), SKU → **Create**. If the name is taken, tell Claude; a new candidate will be chosen.

steps.title: Create the app in Play Console
steps.detail: **Create app** → name, default language, *App* / *Free* or *Paid*, tick the declarations → **Create app**. The package name gets locked when the first AAB is uploaded (**play-testers** record).

warnings: Do not act in the wrong account: the account/team name on the page must match the one in the **store-accounts** record (RULES.md Section 12.8).
Once a package name has been used, it cannot be changed or reused for another app.

fields.label: The app record was created in App Store Connect **in the right team**
